title: PerceiveImagine
description: An EEG dataset of a perception and mental imagery task. Participants viewed an image for 6 seconds in response to an auditory prompt, then closed their eyes and imagined the same image for 6 seconds. A further prompt sound started the next trial. The recordings can be used to study neural correlates of visual perception versus imagery and to develop decoding methods.
methods_description: Each trial consisted of a 6-second image perception period, followed by eyes-closed mental imagery of the viewed image for 6 seconds. An auditory prompt cued the start of the next trial.
